translation_utility_evidence.scope: Static readable lookup path; an individual client’s selected language and display state are not observed.

method: Exact native gear/BP IDs from preview packets; typed item_data name field and exact backward localization object; installed English TID lookup by exact full or suffix-stripped source text. Independently read Forge catalog/artwork manifest. Direct catalog anchor requires numeric /images/entities/<gear ID>.png URL and exact installed English name. For two direct anchors outside preview, independently decode exact gear→blueprint suffix. Additional tier row inherits catalog candidate only if its exact native blueprint ID and exact installed English name both equal a direct anchor.
identity_gate: Installed English name is source-qualified to exact item ID. Name-only equality cannot promote a Forge catalog identity. Numeric artwork entity ID plus installed English name, and exact same-blueprint/same-name propagation from that anchor, are source-backed existing-catalog crosswalks; the artwork manifest is an older community asset index, not proof of current availability or importer acceptance. Blueprint titles remain separately keyed by exact blueprint ID. Distinct `.96` blueprint IDs are not merged by similar names.

quarantine_summary.rule: Keep the installed gear title and installed blueprint title as separate exact-ID labels; title disagreement is an alias/conflict to display, not a reason to discard the numeric native gear→blueprint identity.
